Booster K1

Introductory Embodied Development Platform

Buy now

Shot in camera, no AI

Lightweight Design

Compact Body, Go Anywhere

Compact and Easy to Take Anywhere. A compact body and built-in carrying handle make transport and setup easier. Whether in the classroom, on the competition field, or in the lab, Booster K1 is quick to get into place whenever you need it.

Standing height
Approx.95cm
Total weight
Approx.19.5kg

No battery swapping required, keep developing. Both the Education and Professional editions are equipped with a 5Ah magnetic battery, delivering up to 70 minutes of walking runtime. It can be charged directly without disassembly, supporting charging while in use. The magnetic connector quickly detaches if the charging cable is accidentally pulled, reducing the risk of the robot falling or the port being damaged.

Booster App. Set up the robot's network connection via Bluetooth, view live camera feeds and operating status, and control movement, common actions, and Agents. Connect, monitor, and control, all in one app.

Voice Interaction. Have real-time conversations in Chinese or English, and give voice commands to move, turn, wave, or shake hands. Choose from multiple personas and customize conversation settings for more natural interaction.

Handheld Controller. Responsive and easy to use. Use the thumbsticks to control walking and turning, and the directional buttons to adjust the head. Button combinations let you switch modes and Agents, and trigger common actions.

Locomotion Performance

Stay Steady and Explore More

Agile Movement and Steady Control. Booster K1 has 22 degrees of freedom: 2 in the head, 8 across both arms, and 12 across both legs. It supports forward and backward walking, lateral movement, turning, and combinations of these movements, with walking speeds of up to 2 m/s and turning speeds of up to 1.5 rad/s. On uneven ground or when affected by external forces, it can actively adjust its posture and attempt to regain balance.

Full-body degrees of freedom
22
Walking speed
2m/s
Turning speed
1.5rad/s

Takes a Hit. Gets Back Up. When pushed or hit, K1 actively adjusts its posture to recover balance. If knocked down, it can get back up autonomously and keep moving.

Repeated Impacts
Active Balance Recovery
Fall Recovery
Auto Get-Up

Automatic Protection, One-Tap Emergency Stop. K1 automatically stops active motion when a fall or abnormal condition occurs, helping reduce damage. A soft emergency stop can be triggered with a single action via the controller, app, or onboard buttons. Timely alerts for low battery levels and overheating provide added peace of mind throughout use.

Intelligent Experiences

More Skilled，More Fun

Agents Ready Out of the Box

From everyday actions and soccer to real-time conversations, dance, and martial arts moves, six types of Agents are built into the system and ready to use out of the box. The Agent library continues to evolve with system updates, bringing new skills to discover each time you meet Booster K1.

Instantly shifts personas. A playful kid, a smart tutor, or a loyal pet. Ready for casual banter or simply keeping you company.

It tracks, chases, and shoots—all on its own. After a goal, it nails the signature celebrations of Messi and Ronaldo, or breaks into a Waka Waka dance. It owns the field.

From traditional folk to modern street and classic ballroom, it knows the rhythm. It even pulls off high-difficulty moves like a spin kick.

Dedicated to tradition. It executes the authentic Southern lion dance with absolute precision, bringing folklore to life.

Open Ecosystem

Truly Open, Truly Limitless

Powerful Compute. Multimodal Perception. Up to 200 TOPS of on-device AI compute gives your ideas room to grow. With a stereo depth camera, a 9-axis IMU, a microphone array, and a speaker, the robot brings together the sensing and computing capabilities needed to develop visual perception, voice interaction, and motion algorithms.

Easy to Start. Open to Go Further. SDK support for Python and C++, an Agent development framework, and open-source resources for simulation-based training make it easy to get started and support advanced custom development. Whether you're exploring humanoid robots for the first time or going deeper into embodied intelligence applications, K1 gives you room to follow your curiosity.

One Platform from Idea to Deployment. From Agent development, simulation validation, and robot-state debugging to deployment on physical robots, Booster Studio brings the entire workflow together in one place. Simulation and physical robots share the same codebase, so you can deploy with one click after validation. Built-in Vibe Coding understands your development intent and generates code automatically, helping turn ideas into working applications faster.

Customer Cases

Clean sweep of top three places in Middle-Size Group at the World Humanoid Robot Games

RoboCup 2026 Middle Division Champion — B-Human (Germany)
